description: Adds or subtracts a duration (years, months, weeks, days, hours, minutes, seconds) to a date/time. Use negative numbers to subtract. Calendar-aware: adding 1 month to Jan 31 gives Feb 28/29, and adding days keeps the same local clock time across daylight-saving changes.

datetime.description: Date/time in ISO 8601 (e.g. "2026-03-08T14:30", "2026-03-08T14:30:00Z", "2026-03-08"), "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm", a Unix timestamp in seconds or milliseconds, or "now".

timezone.description: Time zone the arithmetic happens in. IANA time zone name, e.g. "America/New_York", "Europe/London", "Asia/Tokyo", or "UTC". Fixed offsets like "UTC+5:30" also work. Defaults to UTC.

name: date_add
title: Add or subtract time
